Method of Attack: Detects KARMA attacks, a WiFi Man-in-the-Middle attack where an attacker configures an evil access point to respond to probe requests from devices looking for previously connected WiFi networks, fooling devices into connecting to malicious networks
PiDense monitors suspicious or illegal wireless networks
PiFinger searches for WiFi Pineapple traces and calculates wireless network security score
WiPi-Hunter provides open-source tools for detecting various WiFi-based attacks
Impacted Systems: USB-based plug-in WiFi cards (e.g., TP LINK TL-WN722N, Dark RangeMax)
Attack Vector: WiFi networks via KARMA and MANA WiFi Man-in-the-Middle attacks
Indicators of Compromise: Deauth requests sent to disconnect from malicious networks
